mapper.select: SELECT cour.course_id as course_id , cour.title as title , cour.content as content , u.name as inst_name , cour.start_date as start_date , cour.end_date as end_date , period_diff(LEFT(REPLACE(cour.end_date, '-',''),6),LEFT(REPLACE(cour.start_date, '-',''),6)) as period_cnt , stu_cour.stu_cnt as stu_cnt ,cla.people_limit as people_limit ,round( (IFNULL(cour_att.출석횟수, 0) / (GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), cour.start_date), 1) * IFNULL(stu_cour.stu_cnt, 1))) * 100 , 2) as att_ratio ,round((cour_att_per.지각횟수/(22*stu_cour.stu_cnt)),2) as per_ratio ,round((cour_att_abs.결석횟수/(22*stu_cour.stu_cnt)),2) as abs_ratio ,cour_cnt.강의횟수 as cour_cnt FROM course cour left join tb_userinfo u on cour.professor = u.loginID left join course_class cla on cour.class_id = cla.class_id left join (SELECT course_id, count(1) as stu_cnt, stu_cou_sta_code FROM student_course WHERE stu_cou_sta_code = 0 GROUP BY 1, 3 ) stu_cour on stu_cour.course_id = cour.course_id left join (SELECT COUNT(1) as 출석횟수 ,course_id FROM course_attendance WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND att_sta_code = 1 AND DAYOFWEEK(date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY 2) cour_att on cour_att.course_id = stu_cour.course_id left join (SELECT COUNT(1) as 지각횟수 ,course_id FROM course_attendance WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND att_sta_code = 2 AND DAYOFWEEK(date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY 2) cour_att_per on cour_att_per.course_id = stu_cour.course_id left join (SELECT COUNT(1) as 결석횟수 ,course_id FROM course_attendance WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND att_sta_code = 0 AND DAYOFWEEK(date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY 2) cour_att_abs on cour_att_abs.course_id = stu_cour.course_id left join (SELECT course_id, (count(distinct substr(date,1,10))) as 강의횟수 FROM course_attendance GROUP BY 1 ) cour_cnt on cour_cnt.course_id = cour.course_id WHERE (cour.professor = #{loginID} OR cour.sub_prof = #{loginID}) AND cour.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

SELECT cour.course_id , cour.title , cla.class_name , cour.class_id , cour.time_code , substr(cour.start_date, 1, 10) AS start_date , substr(cour.end_date, 1, 10) AS end_date FROM course cour LEFT JOIN course_class cla ON cour.class_id = cla.class_id WHERE cour.course_isDeleted = 0 AND cour.start_date <= #{weekEnd} AND cour.end_date >= #{weekStart} ORDER BY cla.class_name, cour.time_code

SELECT cour.course_id as course_id , cour.title as title ,u.name as inst_name , substr(cour.start_date,1,10) as start_date , substr(cour.end_date,1,10) as end_date , period_diff(LEFT(REPLACE(cour.end_date, '-',''),6),LEFT(REPLACE(cour.start_date, '-',''),6)) as period_cnt , stu_cour.stu_cnt as stu_cnt , cla.people_limit as people_limit , round((cour_att.출석횟수/(22*stu_cour.stu_cnt)) * 100,2) as att_ratio FROM course cour left join tb_userinfo u on cour.professor = u.loginID left join course_class cla on cour.class_id = cla.class_id left join (SELECT course_id, count(1) as stu_cnt, stu_cou_sta_code FROM student_course WHERE stu_cou_sta_code = 0 GROUP BY 1, 3 ) stu_cour on stu_cour.course_id = cour.course_id left join (SELECT COUNT(1) as 출석횟수 ,course_id FROM course_attendance WHERE att_sta_code = 1 AND DAYOFWEEK(date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 GROUP BY 2) cour_att on cour_att.course_id = stu_cour.course_id
(cour.professor = #{loginID} OR cour.sub_prof = #{loginID}) AND cour.course_isDeleted = 0
and cour.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
and u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND 1=2
and start_date >= #{search_sdate} and end_date < #{search_edate}
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 ORDER BY start_date desc LIMIT #{pageIndex}, #{pageSize}
